annotations.title: Agent memory, list keys: what a namespace holds

description: List up to 100 keys saved in your namespace, optionally only those starting with a prefix, with their size, save time and expiry; pass the returned cursor for the next page. Values are not included (read them with /memory/get). Values are kept until they expire (at most 30 days) or are deleted; reads anywhere may lag a write made elsewhere by up to a minute. Use to see what an agent has saved. Example: namespace=demo-agent-memory-7f3c9a21. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page of this list

namespace.description: Your namespace: a secret of 16 to 128 letters, digits, - or _ that you choose and reuse. Anyone who knows it can read and write it, so treat it like a password; send it in a POST body to keep it out of URLs.

prefix.description: Only keys that start with this text
